meta.name: golden-rss-empty
meta.description: Use when testing the empty rss golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证空RSS的构建流程
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify empty RSS build process

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会识别一个名为 Quiet Feed 的 Atom 订阅源，并知道它当前有 0 篇文章、0 个作者、0 个分类。它会把该源视为空 feed，用于测试空 RSS golden build 的场景。
howto.when: 当用户要求测试『空的 RSS golden build』时触发；或当用户请求查看 Quiet Feed 的文章、作者、分类等内容时，Claude 也会基于该技能响应，但结果为空。

say.note: Claude 会调用该技能并返回空 feed 信息。

say.text: 帮我查一下 Quiet Feed 里有什么文章
say.note: 会返回 0 篇文章的查询结果。

say.text: 看看 Quiet Feed 的 Atom 源有哪些更新
say.note: 会确认该源暂无任何发布内容。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude recognizes an Atom feed 'Quiet Feed' with 0 articles, 0 authors, 0 categories. It treats it as an empty feed, for testing the empty RSS golden build.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to test the empty RSS golden build, or when requesting content (articles, authors, categories, etc.) from Quiet Feed. Claude will respond, but the result is empty.

say_en.text: Test the empty RSS golden build
say_en.note: Claude will use the skill and return empty feed info.

say_en.text: What articles are in Quiet Feed?
say_en.note: Returns a query result of 0 articles.

say_en.text: Any updates from the Quiet Feed Atom source?
say_en.note: Confirms the feed has no published content yet.
